architectureDecisions: Compare fixed maxAttempts, repeat fingerprint stop, and one explicit feedback escalation; keep maxAttempts as an outer hard ceiling and preserve opt-in/default compatibility until measured.

Do not skip correctness verification solely because a cached hash matches. Any verifier cache requires immutable evaluator/config/environment identity and fresh acceptance; begin with fewer dispatches, not cached PASS.
Feedback carries exact named failed checks with bounded actionable context. Cross-episode learning and semantic FeedbackResolution remain BB-085/086.
